flags.name: Chilli - Flake / Crushed
flags.issue: PACK/UNIT: costed at $13.70 per 'bag' with no bag weight captured (invoice 7111314 states raw_uom 'BAG', pack_qty 1, no mass). Every comparable dry spice in the DB is costed per gram - including an existing near-duplicate 'Chilli Flakes' at $0.020000/g - so any recipe calling chilli flakes in grams cannot cost against this record. needs_pack_review is FALSE, so this will NOT be surfaced to the chef on its own. Name, cost magnitude and food-category all check out: $13.70/bag implies $0.0274/g at 500g or $0.0137/g at 1kg, both in line with the existing $0.020/g entry, so this is a unit problem, not a price problem.
flags.suggested_fix: Confirm the bag weight from the B&E catalogue (befoodsonline.com.au, supplier_code 28087) - the portal would not load during this run and the invoice does not state a mass, so the weight was NOT guessed. Once confirmed, add a pack_overrides.yaml entry mapping 28087 to that weight in g so it costs per gram, and decide whether it should merge with the existing 'Chilli Flakes' ingredient rather than sit alongside it.
